race.comment: RAVENS GLOW (11) has found an ideal race to knock the maiden off. Two runs back this time in have been good, placing in both to make it five minor placings from six starts. This race lacks depth and with any luck from the slightly sticky gate she can get the job done. SAN PUEBLO (7) made sharp improvement second up when beaten a head at this track and trip, showing speed and sticking on well. Should be peaking now and can give a sight again. HILOVELY (8) is a mare by Wandjina on debut for the Tolson & Proctor yard. She's jumped out well enough and draws low, consider. MR JAMESON (6) is a gelding by Doubtland on debut for the Kelly yard who can run well first time out. THE SECRET (12) next best.
